unitTitle: Prepositions of Place - Was/Were - Had - Could

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in was, wasn't, were or weren't. (continued from page 39)
exercises.instructionUz: was, wasn't, were yoki weren't ni qo'ying. (39-betdan davomi)
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 39-betdagi 3-mashqning DAVOMI (8, 9, 10-bandlar).

QOIDA O'SHA-O'SHA:
  I, he, she, it → was / wasn't
  you, we, they  → were / weren't
  There + birlik → there was / wasn't
  There + ko'plik → there were / weren't

YANGI IBORA — 'What ... LIKE?':
  'What was he like?' = U qanday odam edi? (XARAKTER)
  Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     He was quiet and kind.  ✓
     He was like quiet.      ✗ XATO

items.textEn: 8  What ............ your brother like when he ............ young?  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'your brother' BIRLIK → WAS.
'What was ... like?' = ... qanday odam edi?

items.textEn: 8  What ............ your brother like when he ............ young?  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'he' BIRLIK → WAS.
'when he was young' = yosh bo'lganida.

items.textEn: 9  I called David, but he ............ at home.
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: qo'ng'iroq qildim, LEKIN u uyda EMAS edi.
'he' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
'to call' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

items.textEn: 10  ............ there a theatre here ten years ago?
items.whyUz:
'a theatre' BIRLIK → WAS.
So'roq gapda 'Was there ...?' — 'Was' boshda.
'ten years ago' → o'tgan zamon.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in am, is, are, was or were.
exercises.instructionUz: am, is, are, was yoki were ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ ENG MUHIM — HOZIRGI va O'TGAN ARALASH!

IKKI BOSQICHDA HAL QILINADI:

  1-BOSQICH: ZAMONNI aniqlang.
     HOZIRGI belgilari:  now, today, at the moment,
                         It's my birthday!
     O'TGAN belgilari:   last night, in 1980, once,
                         yesterday

  2-BOSQICH: EGAGA qarang.
     HOZIRGI:  I → AM;  he/she/it → IS;  you/we/they → ARE
     O'TGAN:   I/he/she/it → WAS;  you/we/they → WERE

TO'LIQ JADVAL:
         HOZIRGI    O'TGAN
  I        am         was
  he/she/it is        was
  you/we/they are     were

DIQQAT — 'THERE IS/ARE' va 'THERE WAS/WERE':
  keyingi ot BIRLIK  → is / was
  keyingi ot KO'PLIK → are / were

DIQQAT — YOSH AYTISH:
  I AM twelve years old.   (hozir)
  I WAS ten years old.     (o'tgan)
  O'zbekchada 'yoshdaman', ingliz tilida 'BEING' fe'li bilan.

items.textEn: 1  ............ you at the sports centre last night?
items.whyUz:
'last night' → O'TGAN zamon.
'you' → WERE.
So'roq gapda boshda.

items.textEn: 2  In 1980 I ............ ten years old.
items.whyUz:
'In 1980' → O'TGAN zamon.
'I' → WAS.
DIQQAT: yosh aytishda 'to be' fe'li ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 3  There ............ a supermarket in my area now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'a supermarket' BIRLIK → THERE IS.
'an area' = hudud (39-betda ham bor).

items.textEn: 4  Now, I ............ a student at the local school.
items.whyUz:
'Now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'I' → AM (bu YAGONA shakl).
'local' = mahalliy.

items.textEn: 5  My parents ............ at work at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' = ayni damda → HOZIRGI zamon.
'My parents' KO'PLIK → ARE.

items.textEn: 6  There ............ green fields here once.
items.whyUz:
'once' bu yerda = bir vaqtlar, ilgari → O'TGAN zamon.
'green fields' KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
DIQQAT: 'once' 'bir marta' ma'nosini ham beradi.

items.textEn: 7  It's my birthday! I ............ twelve years old today.
items.whyUz:
'today' va 'It's my birthday!' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'I' → AM.
2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'In 1980' → was.

items.textEn: 8  I ............ with Andrea yesterday.
items.whyUz:
'yesterday' = kecha → O'TGAN zamon.
'I' → WAS.

items.textEn: 9  There ............ many hotels in the city centre now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'many hotels' KO'PLIK → THERE ARE.
'the city centre' = shahar markazi.

items.textEn: 10  There ............ an airport in my town now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'an airport' BIRLIK → THERE IS.
9-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ko'plik edi → are.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ RASM:
  dog, car, watch, ball, doll, bike, radio, guitar, umbrella

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did you have a dog when you were four years old?
  SB: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

QOLIP:
  SA: DID you HAVE a/an [narsa] when you WERE four years old?
  SB: Yes, I DID. / No, I DIDN'T.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) So'roqda 'HAVE' (had EMAS):
        Did you HAVE a car?   ✓
        Did you HAD a car?    ✗ XATO

  2) Qisqa javobda 'DID' (had EMAS):
        Yes, I DID.   ✓
        Yes, I HAD.   ✗ XATO

  3) 'when you WERE four' — 'you' DOIM were.

DIQQAT — A yoki AN:
  undosh tovush oldidan → A  (a dog, a car, a ball)
  unli tovush oldidan   → AN (an umbrella)

JAVOB SHAXSIY:
  Har kim o'zi haqida javob beradi —
  'Yes, I did.' yoki 'No, I didn't.'

items.question: Did you have a dog when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'a dog' — undosh tovush → A.
So'roqda 'have', qisqa javobda 'did'.

items.question: Did you have a car when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a car' — undosh tovush → A.

items.question: Did you have a watch when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz:
'a watch' = qo'l soati.
DIQQAT: 'a clock' — devor/stol soati, 'a watch' — qo'l soati.

items.question: Did you have a ball when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a ball' = to'p.

items.question: Did you have a doll when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a doll' = qo'g'irchoq (Coursebook 66-betda ham bor).

items.question: Did you have a bike when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a bike' = velosiped ('a bicycle' ning qisqa shakli).

items.question: Did you have a radio when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a radio' — 'r' undosh tovush → A ('an radio' XATO).

items.question: Did you have a guitar when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz: 'a guitar' = gitara, /ɡɪˈtɑː/ — urg'u 2-bo'g'inda.

items.question: Did you have an umbrella when you were four years old?
items.answer: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT: 'AN umbrella' — 'u' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi.
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA 'an' oladigan so'z.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table about Laura.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:

                       5 yoshda    Hozir (21 yoshda)
  play tennis            ✗              ✓
  cook                   ✗              ✗
  use a computer         ✗              ✓
  ride a horse           ✗              ✓
  paint                  ✗              ✓
  play the piano         ✗              ✗

CHAP ustunda HAMMASI ✗ — besh yoshida hech narsa
qila olmasdi. Farq faqat O'NG ustunda.

SHUNING UCHUN IKKI XIL GAP BOR:

  ✗ → ✓  (endi qila oladi):
     Laura couldn't ... when she was five years old,
     BUT she CAN ... now.

  ✗ → ✗  (hali ham qila olmaydi):
     Laura couldn't ... when she was five years old
     AND she STILL CAN'T ... .

DIQQAT — 'STILL':
  'still' = hali ham, hanuz.
  Inkorda 'still' CAN'T dan OLDIN keladi:
     she still can't cook.   ✓
     she can't still cook.   ✗

DIQQAT — 'THE' PIANO:
  cholg'u asboblari oldidan THE:
     play THE piano, play THE guitar, play THE violin
  Sport oldidan THE YO'Q:
     play tennis, play football

points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
✗→✗ bo'lgani uchun 'and she still can't'.

points.en: use a computer — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✓
ride a horse — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✓
play the piano — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✗

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and make sentences about Laura, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va Laura haqida namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QOLIP:

  ✗ → ✓ :  Laura couldn't [fe'l] when she was five years
           old, BUT she can [fe'l] now.

  ✗ → ✗ :  Laura couldn't [fe'l] when she was five years
           old AND she still can't [fe'l].

KITOB IKKALA NAMUNANI ham bergan (tennis va cook).

items.textEn: play tennis  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✓)
items.answer: Laura couldn't play tennis when she was five years old, but she can play tennis now.
items.whyUz:
✗ → ✓ → 'but she CAN ... now'.
'couldn't' — o'tgan, 'can' — hozirgi.
Sport oldidan 'the' yo'q.

items.textEn: cook  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✗)
items.answer: Laura couldn't cook when she was five years old and she still can't cook.
items.whyUz:
✗ → ✗ → 'AND she STILL CAN'T ...'.
'still' = hali ham.
'but' EMAS — chunki qarama-qarshilik yo'q.

items.textEn: use a computer  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✓)
items.answer: Laura couldn't use a computer when she was five years old, but she can use a computer now.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish bor → 'but she can ... now'.
'to use a computer' = kompyuterdan foydalanmoq.

items.textEn: ride a horse  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✓)
items.answer: Laura couldn't ride a horse when she was five years old, but she can ride a horse now.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish bor → 'but ... can ... now'.
'to ride a horse' = ot minmoq.

items.textEn: paint  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✓)
items.answer: Laura couldn't paint when she was five years old, but she can paint now.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish bor → 'but ... can ... now'.
'to paint' = bo'yoq bilan rasm chizmoq.

items.textEn: play the piano  (5 yosh: ✗ → hozir: ✗)
items.answer: Laura couldn't play the piano when she was five years old and she still can't play the piano.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish YO'Q → 'and she still can't ...'.
'the piano' — cholg'u asbobi oldidan THE shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Now write three sentences about yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi o'zingiz haqingizda uchta gap yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
6a dagi IKKALA qolipdan ham foydalaning,
faqat 'Laura' o'rniga 'I' va 'she was' o'rniga 'I was'.

QOLIPLAR:

  ✗ → ✓ :  I couldn't [fe'l] when I was five years old,
           but I can [fe'l] now.

  ✗ → ✗ :  I couldn't [fe'l] when I was five years old
           and I still can't [fe'l].

DIQQAT — EGA O'ZGARSA HAM FE'L O'ZGARMAYDI:
  'could' va 'can' hamma shaxsda BIR XIL —
  'she can' → 'I can' (hech qanday -s yo'q).

FOYDALI FE'LLAR:
  swim, read, write, ride a bicycle, drive a car,
  cook, paint, play the guitar, use a computer,
  speak English, count

structure.heading: 1  ✗ → ✓  (endi qila olaman)
structure.modelEn: I couldn't read when I was five years old, but I can read now.

structure.heading: 2  ✗ → ✓  (yana bitta)
structure.guideUz: Boshqa fe'l tanlang — masalan velosiped yoki suzish.
structure.modelEn: I couldn't ride a bicycle when I was five years old, but I can ride a bicycle now.

structure.heading: 3  ✗ → ✗  (hali ham qila olmayman)
structure.guideUz:
'and I still can't ...' qolipi bilan.
'still' — 'can't' dan OLDIN.
structure.modelEn: I couldn't drive a car when I was five years old and I still can't drive a car.

exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ BUTUN UNITNI TEKSHIRADI.

TANLASH UCHUN UCH SAVOL:

  1) ZAMON qaysi?
       O'TGAN belgilari: last night, 100 years ago,
          when I was ..., last year, thirty years ago
       HOZIRGI: vaqt belgisi YO'Q yoki 'now'

  2) EGA birlikmi, ko'plikmi?
       birlik → was / wasn't
       ko'plik → were / weren't

  3) 'DID/DIDN'T' dan keyin qaysi shakl?
       DOIM asosiy shakl: HAVE (had EMAS)

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN UCH XATO:
  didn't HAD    ✗  →  didn't HAVE   ✓
  he WEREN'T    ✗  →  he WASN'T     ✓
  There WEREN'T a cinema  ✗  →  There WASN'T a cinema  ✓

items.textEn: 1  Can / Could you ride a motorbike?
items.whyUz:
Gapda O'TGAN zamon belgisi YO'Q ('when I was ...' yo'q) →
HOZIRGI qobiliyat so'ralmoqda → CAN.
'a motorbike' = mototsikl.

items.textEn: 2  We didn't had / have a TV when I was little.
items.whyUz:
'didn't' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan →
keyingi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: HAVE.
'didn't had' — eng ko'p uchraydigan XATO.
'little' bu yerda = kichkina, yosh.

items.textEn: 3  "Was / Were your brother a quiet child?"  [1-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'your brother' BIRLIK → WAS.
'quiet' = kamgap, tinch.

items.textEn: 3  "No, he weren't / wasn't."  [2-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'he' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
'he weren't' — XATO.

items.textEn: 4  There are / were telephones 100 years ago.
items.whyUz:
'100 years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'telephones' KO'PLIK → WERE.
Coursebook 65-betda ham: telefon 1876-yilda ixtiro qilingan.

items.textEn: 5  I had / have a bike when I was five, ...  [1-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'when I was five' → O'TGAN zamon → HAD.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'did' yo'q, shuning uchun HAD to'g'ri
(2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'didn't' bor edi).

items.textEn: 5  ... but I can't / couldn't ride it.  [2-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
Gapning boshi O'TGAN zamonda ('when I was five') →
davomi ham o'tgan → COULDN'T.
Ma'nosi: velosipedim bor edi, lekin hayday olmasdim.

items.textEn: 6  Were / Was you at home last night?
items.whyUz:
'you' → DOIM WERE (birlik ma'noda ham).
'Was you' — XATO.

items.textEn: 7  Jill couldn't / can't drive when she was ten years old.
items.whyUz:
'when she was ten years old' → O'TGAN zamon → COULDN'T.
'to drive' = mashina haydamoq.

items.textEn: 8  There wasn't / weren't many shops here thirty years ago.
items.whyUz:
'many shops' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.
'thirty years ago' → o'tgan zamon.

items.textEn: 9  I didn't had / have a computer last year.  [1-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'didn't' + ASOSIY shakl → HAVE.
2-band bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 9  I had / have a typewriter.  [2-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'last year' → O'TGAN zamon, va 'did' YO'Q →
fe'lning o'zi o'tgan shaklda: HAD.
9-bandning ikki qismini solishtiring:
  didn't HAVE (did bor) ↔ HAD (did yo'q).
'a typewriter' = yozuv mashinkasi.

items.textEn: 10  Could / Couldn't you read when you were four years old?
items.whyUz:
Oddiy so'roq gap → COULD.
'Couldn't you ...?' — hayron bo'lish yoki tanbeh ma'nosini beradi
('Nahotki o'qiy olmasang?').

items.textEn: 11  They wasn't / weren't at the party last night.
items.whyUz: 'They' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.

items.textEn: 12  Was / Were there a hotel here twenty years ago?
items.whyUz:
'a hotel' BIRLIK → WAS.
DIQQAT: 'there' ga emas, KEYINGI OTGA qaraladi.

items.textEn: 13  There weren't / wasn't a cinema here when I was a child.
items.whyUz:
'a cinema' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
8-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'many shops' ko'plik edi.

items.textEn: 14  We had / have a dog last year.
items.whyUz:
'last year' → O'TGAN zamon.
'did' YO'Q → fe'lning o'zi o'tgan shaklda: HAD.

items.textEn: 15  "Can't / Can you play the violin?"  [1-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
Oddiy so'roq gap → CAN.
'the violin' — cholg'u asbobi oldidan THE.

items.textEn: 15  "No, I can't / can."  [2-tanlov]
items.whyUz:
'No, ...' → INKOR javob → CAN'T.
'No, I can' — mantiqan XATO.

wordFormation.introUz: 40-bet — hozirgi/o'tgan aralash, buyumlar lug'ati, cholg'u va sport.

groups.explanationUz: A yoki AN ni to'g'ri tanlang.
Ustiga minilsa — ride;  ichiga o'tirilsa — drive.

items.baseUz: Men hali ham shu yerda yashayman.

patterns.formula: DID + ega + HAVE + ot + when you WERE ... years old?  →  Yes, I DID. / No, I DIDN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Did you have a dog when you were four years old? — Yes, I did.
patterns.exampleUz: To'rt yoshingda iting bormidi? — Ha, bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz: So'roqda HAVE, qisqa javobda DID — ikkisini aralashtirmang.

patterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when she was ... , BUT she CAN + fe'l + NOW.
patterns.exampleEn: Laura couldn't play tennis when she was five years old, but she can play tennis now.
patterns.exampleUz: Laura besh yoshida tennis o'ynay olmasdi, lekin hozir o'ynay oladi.

patterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when she was ... AND she STILL CAN'T + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Laura couldn't cook when she was five years old and she still can't cook.
patterns.exampleUz: Laura besh yoshida ovqat pishira olmasdi va hali ham pishira olmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: There wasn't a cinema here when I was a child. There weren't many shops here thirty years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Men bola bo'lganimda bu yerda kinoteatr yo'q edi. O'ttiz yil oldin bu yerda ko'p do'kon yo'q edi.

patterns.formula: I AM ... years old (hozir)  ↔  I WAS ... years old (o'tgan).
patterns.exampleEn: I am twelve years old today. In 1980 I was ten years old.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun o'n ikki yoshdaman. 1980-yilda o'n yoshda edim.
patterns.explanationUz: Yosh aytishda ingliz tilida 'to be' fe'li ishlatiladi.
